answer: In PoA, each challenge commits to a domain-separated transcript incorporating a future drand threshold-BLS beacon pulse revealed only after submission. Because the pulse is unpredictable and collectively unbiasable, an agent cannot precompute answers, select favorable instances, or farm them offline across sybil identities. Verification binds every response to that pulse, making mass automation costly; even a haven, fable, or relic of cached work provides no reusable advantage.
